name: episode
description: Episodes bound a piece of work so the organization can learn from it. op=open {title, participants?} | close {episode_id, outcome: success|failure|partial|cancelled, summary, evidence?} | reflect {episode_id, body}. Reflect on friction you saw: what went wrong between members, what would prevent it next time.

name: protocol
description: Organization protocols. op=propose: weak {title, rationale, guidance, trigger, scope?, evidence} is shared guidance; strong {title, rationale, episode_id (closed, reflected), rules: [rule]} is enforced on tool calls by the hook. Revise with supersedes, retire with retire_target. A proposal becomes active when the organization's approval threshold is reached. op=vote {protocol_id, vote: approve|reject, reason}. op=use {protocol_id, outcome: followed|deviated|inapplicable, note} reports actual use. op=list.

items.description: effect: deny | require_review | require_before. tools: tool-name globs such as Bash, Edit, Write. Optional: input_contains [substrings of the tool input], path_glob (file path pattern), members/roles it applies to, except_members/except_roles (e.g. the owner), before {tools, input_contains} for require_before, reason.

name: review
